name: Economic Security Project
summary: A New York-based US non-profit founded in 2016 that campaigns for cash policies and against corporate concentration: state child and earned income tax credits, guaranteed income (it funded the Stockton pilot and convenes the national movement), the IRS's free Direct File service, and public options such as city-run grocery stores. This is its 501(c)(3), Economic Security Project Inc, tax-exempt since 2021; its sister Economic Security Project Action is a 501(c)(4), and gifts to it aren't tax-deductible. In 2024 the 501(c)(3) spent $10.2 million, $1.7 million of it in grants to state and national partners.
